decisions.reason: As a visible 2019 launch that extends the firm's airport service bundle, the app is likely to be retained because management can justify weak uptake as temporary, though its relatively modest investment and somewhat peripheral fit make withdrawal plausible.

PassBoard received the strongest public launch and appears closest to the firm's stated innovation-led direction in airport security and processing, so escalation of commitment makes management unlikely to abandon it quickly.

The self-service check-in solution fits the firm's push into integrated technology for airport clients and likely required meaningful development effort, so management would tend to continue it unless results were clearly poor.
